nights.extract: Amos the Transparent is a Canadian rock band from Ottawa, Ontario. Members are Jonathan Chandler, Olenka Reshitnyk, Dan Hay (guitar), James Nicol, drummer Christopher Wilson and cellist Mike Yates.
